traditionalDress.men: Dhoti-kurta or regional woven textiles; a gamusa is an important Assamese textile and cultural symbol.
traditionalDress.women: Mekhela chador, often woven in muga, eri or pat silk depending on the textile tradition.

festivals.name: Bohag Bihu (Rongali Bihu)
festivals.description: The spring and new-year festival, celebrated with Bihu songs, dance, feasting and community gatherings.

festivals.name: Magh Bihu (Bhogali Bihu)
festivals.description: A harvest festival associated with feasting, community fires and the end of the winter agricultural cycle.

festivals.name: Kati Bihu (Kangali Bihu)
festivals.description: A more austere observance associated with prayer and lamps during the crop-growing season.

cuisine: Duck with sesame or regional preparations
folklore: Assam's folklore encompasses riverine and agrarian life, Vaishnavite storytelling, Bihu songs and legends connected with the Brahmaputra valley and its diverse communities.
